title: Third Carnatic War & English success
quote: Chandurti (1758) = foundation of British rule in Andhra, as Plassey (1757) is for India

items.what: Lally takes **Fort St. David**; fails at Madras, **Thanjavur**

boxes.title: Andhra theatre
items: Chandurti drove French out of the ==**Northern Circars**==; Malleson: small battle, great results
**Salabat Jang** gave English **Machilipatnam, Nizampatnam, Vakal Mannar**, part of **Kondapalli**
**Ananda Gajapati** beat Jagapati Raju at **Konduru**; died of smallpox **1760**

boxes.title: Treaty of Paris (1763)
items: Ended **Seven Years' War** + Third Carnatic War
French settlements restored only as ==trading posts; **could not be fortified**==
European link: Indian theatre of **Seven Years' War (1756-63)**
Bengal: **Plassey (1757)** + Chandernagore → revenue paid for Carnatic campaign

head: Factor

French
